newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes raided suspected Islamic guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Friday, security sources said.

They said the planes fired at least eight rockets in two bombing runs into Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack, the first Israeli raid into Lebanon in 1997.

Hizbollah is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 allied South Lebanon Army militiamen from a border occupation zone set up in south Lebanon in 1985 to ward off guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
